EMPLOYEES' MINIMUM STANDARDS OF HOUSING, ACCOMMODATIONS AND

AMENITIES ACT 1990

EMPLOYEES' MINIMUM STANDARDS OF HOUSING, ACCOMMODATIONS AND

AMENITIES (VESTING OF POWERS) (NO. 4) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 26(1) of the

Employees' Minimum Standards of Housing, Accommodations and Amenities Act 1990

[Act 446], the Minister makes the following order:

Name

1. This order may be cited as the Employees' Minimum Standards of Housing,

Accommodations and Amenities (Vesting of Powers) (No. 4) Order 2021.

Vesting of powers

2. The Minister vests in the officers specified in column (1) of the Schedule all powers

conferred upon the Director General by the Act except the powers conferred by the

provisions specified in column (2).
